note: Explicit, reviewable exceptions for historical findings only. Every entry must name a commit, path, reason and status. New findings are never suppressed. See SECURITY.md. Status 'revoked' means the owner confirmed the credential itself was rotated and disabled on 2026-11-05; it does NOT mean the plaintext was removed from git history. Entries stay registered because the full-history diffs still contain that value and the detection rule stays active.
revocation_scope: Owner confirmed rotation and disablement of the webhook; the historical URL is no longer a valid credential. Git history was NOT rewritten, so the plaintext remains retrievable. Call-log review, possible unauthorized use and any additional leakage channel are NOT confirmed by this repository. See SECURITY.md and ADR 0002.
